import socket,sys,time,json
import arena

def analyze(board,secs=60,roots=None):
 s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
 def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
 send('uci')
 while f.readline().strip()!='uciok':pass
 send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256')
 send('isready')
 while f.readline().strip()!='readyok':pass
 send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in board.move_stack))
 send(f'go movetime {int(secs*1000)}'+(' searchmoves '+' '.join(roots) if roots else ''))
 last=''
 while True:
  l=f.readline().strip()
  if not l:break
  if l.startswith('info depth'):last=l
  if l.startswith('bestmove'):
   print(last,flush=True);print(l,flush=True);send('quit');s.close();return l.split()[1],last
if __name__=='__main__':
 b=arena.load_board(); m,i=analyze(b,float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 60,sys.argv[2:] or None)
 if '--' == 'x':pass

cat > auto.py <<'PY'
import arena,analyze,chess,sys
for _ in range(int(sys.argv[1])):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b): print('RESULT',arena.result(b));break
 m,info=analyze.analyze(b,30)
 bb=b.copy();bb.push_uci(m)
 if bb.is_repetition(2):
  roots=[]
  for move in b.legal_moves:
   bb=b.copy();bb.push(move)
   if not bb.is_repetition(2):roots.append(move.uci())
  m,info=analyze.analyze(b,30,roots)
 print('PLAY',b.fullmove_number,b.san(chess.Move.from_uci(m)),flush=True)
 out=arena._request('move '+m)
 print('REPLY',out.peek().uci(),'FEN',out.fen(),flush=True)
 if arena.result(out): print('RESULT',arena.result(out));break
